headline: US Signs $12 Billion in Commercial Deals During Central Asia Diplomatic Tour
summary: A US delegation led by Secretary of State Marco Rubio finalized $12 billion in commercial agreements with Kazakhstan and Uzbekistan following a Samarkand business forum aimed at deepening economic investments.
why: Central Asia holds significant critical mineral, energy, and transit assets, making US investment agreements strategically important for diversifying global supply chains.

impacts.name: Uzbekistan
impacts.why: Bilateral deals provide substantial capital investment and expand commercial integration with Western markets.
